Name: PFM KEG QUALITY
Author: GranAnt
Description:
Now you can not only have an iridium wine from your harvest with the same quality, but you can also make a sweet gem berry wine with the same rule.
Ahora no solo puedes tener un vino de iridio de tu cosecha con la misma calidad, sino que también puedes hacer un vino de baya de gema dulce con la misma regla.

EN VINOS ES... VALOR BASE DEL CULTIVO X 3 + [CALIDAD FINAL (COMO IRIDIO QUE DUPLICA EL VALOR DEL PRODUCTO)] = VALOR FINAL.
EN JUGOS ES... VALOR BASE DEL CULTIVO X 2.25 + [CALIDAD FINAL (COMO IRIDIO QUE DUPLICA EL VALOR DEL PRODUCTO)] = VALOR FINAL


IN WINES IT IS ... BASE VALUE OF THE CROP X 3 + [FINAL QUALITY (AS IRIDIUM THAT DOUBLES THE VALUE OF THE PRODUCT)] = FINAL VALUE.
IN JUICES IT IS ... BASE VALUE OF THE CROP X 2.25 + [FINAL QUALITY (AS IRIDIUM THAT DOUBLES THE VALUE OF THE PRODUCT)] = FINAL VALUE
